questions.question_bn: Proper rod length 45m। moves parallel at0.6c। measured length কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Length contraction L=L₀√(1−v²/c²)=5×(9)·0.8=4×(9)। transverse direction would unchanged।

questions.question_bn: Particle totalE=2mc²,restmassm=9unit। p/(mc) কত?
